Nicco turns to Brenna, who sits alert despite the illness still clinging to her tall frame. "The eastern bridge is closed," he says.

Brenna's grey eyes flick toward him, noting the information. She says nothing for a moment, processing, then gives a slight nod. "Good to know."

Gerome stands motionless nearby, stone form giving no indication of having heard. Maren remains present in the room as well, though whether she caught the exchange is unestablished.
